race.comment: PEACH GALANTES (16) has not won at around 1100m but brings reliable wet-track figures, a light weight, a good record with Bailie Baker and enough recent-rating substance to be a major threat. RALOS STAR (6) was beaten just under a length in BM58 grade at Sunshine Coast after being slow to begin, and Mark Du Plessis returning is a useful pointer. ROCKY BLONDE (7) won narrowly last time and is holding form well, though she has to prove she can reproduce that win on softer ground. OH PRETTY EMMA (9) is back from an eight-month spell with a Deagon trial behind her. Can threaten fresh. Include in all combinations.
